title: Bias, Data, and Classroom Consequences
description: CAT 531 textbook section connecting bias, data, and classroom consequences to Design Tension Studio map naming a classroom value conflict and negotiated decision, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Identify training-data bias, proxy variables, and aggregate masking in an educational AI tool.
Match the standard of proof for an AI decision to the stakes of its errors, using disaggregated subgroup performance.
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions.
Use annotations, support requests, and revision notes to make a classroom technology decision more defensible.
